d: X-Series Media Presentation Amplifier, 50 W The Crestron® AMP-X50MP is a low-cost audio amplifier solution that is suitable for a variety of applications. It features a compact, surface-mountable design that installs virtually anywhere without requiring an equipment rack.

specs.label: Frequency Response
specs.value: LoZ (4-8 Ohms): 20 Hz to 20kHz; +/-0.5 dB at 1 W; Hi-Z (70V/100V): 90 Hz to 20kHz; +/-3 dB at 1 W; HPF @ 80 Hz (+/-10 Hz),; -12 dB/Octave

specs.label: THD+N
specs.value: < 0.1 % at 1kHz @ -3 dB full rated output power

specs.label: Input Sensitivity
specs.value: 1.23Vrms, +4 dBu balanced; 0.316Vrms, -10 dBV unbalanced; For 25 W @ 8 Ohms; 50 W @ 70V/100V

specs.label: Protection
specs.value: Clip limiter, over current, under voltage, over temperature, DC offset, extreme high frequency

specs.label: Front Panel
specs.value: Metal, black finish with polycarbonate label overlay
